title: Маркеры Предыстории (Before / After)
description: Выбери правильную форму (Какое действие было ПЕРВЫМ?).

items.question: I ___ my homework before I (went / had gone) to bed.
I (finished / had finished) my homework before I ___ to bed.
After she ___ the room, she (watched / had watched) TV.
After she (cleaned / had cleaned) the room, she ___ TV.
We ___ dinner after we (played / had played) tennis.
We (ate / had eaten) dinner after we ___ tennis.
When I ___ , the train (left / had left).
When I (arrived / had arrived), the train ___.
By the time he ___ , we (finished / had finished) the work.
By the time he (came / had come), we ___ the work.
